What if `appliedConfigUri` is a string like "/redfish/v1/Systems/{}/Processors/{}/OperatingConfigsAdditionalStr"?

To make it precise, I think `expectedPrefix` may need to end with "/".
```
    boost::urls::url expectedPrefix = boost::urls::format(
        "/redfish/v1/Systems/{}/Processors/{}/OperatingConfigs/",
        BMCWEB_REDFISH_SYSTEM_URI_NAME, processorId, expectedPrefix);
```
expectedPrefix didn't end with a / before.  There's also no guarantee that the user ended their URI with a /
